rows.title: A germinal products notification starts in its own set, with its own draft, reference and origin page
rows.detail: Sam's 9 October ruling makes germinal products (semen, embryos and ova) a sibling set of live animals in the animals frontend, mounted at /germinal-products with its own journey, flow, obligations, cookies, gateway and set services, its pages copied from the finished live-animals feature folders plus the germinal differences. This row lays that set down and proves it with its first page: a trader who chooses Germinal products on the type question gets a new Draft notification with a GBN-AG reference and lands on the germinal set's own copy of the origin page. The germinal set's end-to-end, accessibility and security checks run inside the existing animals Playwright project.
acceptanceCriteria: Choosing 'Germinal products' on the type question 'What are you importing?' creates a new notification with status Draft and a reference of the form GBN-AG-<two-digit year>-<six characters>, shown in the status strip from the first page, and lands on the germinal products set's 'Origin of the import' page under /germinal-products/notifications/. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-027, -p1-048; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-091; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-055)
No germinal products notification is ever given a reference starting GBN-GP. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-028)

The germinal origin page asks the same questions, with the same heading, hints, options and error messages, as the finished live-animals origin page, and saves its answers to the germinal notification: every live-animal field V4 does not mark animals-only is carried over. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011, -p1-013, -p1-015; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-001-m1, -p1-005, -p1-047)

The germinal set's end-to-end, accessibility and security checks run in the existing animals Playwright project, with no new project: the accessibility checks hold each germinal page to WCAG 2.2 AA on first load and with answers filled, under the suite's existing axe rules, and the security scan drives the germinal pages. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-061, -p1-062, -p1-063)
rows.gate: Look at the germinal set's skeleton (its mount, chrome, category on the stored record, the cross-set guard and its copied origin page) before the other germinal page copies follow it: every later germinal row copies a live-animals feature folder into this set the same way.
notes: Combines the set and its mount (req-1780), the draft and its GBN-AG reference (req-1781) and where the set's specs live (req-1806): none is observable apart from the others, and the origin page is the one page that proves them together. The combiner merges in the other areas' requirements this row held (req-1856, req-1884, req-1885, req-1901, req-1851, req-1907, req-1857, req-1886), which bring the backend category and keep repos backend, frontend, tests.

c-281 (ruled, 9 October afternoon): the INS germinal list's 'Create new' is not built in this programme, so the old first criterion's INS start is removed; the type question is the way in, and the germinal set's own list's 'Create new' is req-127, in the opening-run row.

Ruling claim pm-p3-087 makes inc-141 the germinal set's own copy of the reframed list at the set root, in the germinal-products theme, so it needs this row's set: drop inc-141 from this row's dependsOn (it would make a cycle) and let inc-141 depend on this row. req-1851's 'visiting /germinal-products sends the trader to the INS germinal products list' conflicts with pm-p3-087; that is the dashboard area's to settle.
Copies are taken after this programme builds each live twin (req-1780), so each germinal page row depends on its live row.

rows.title: The germinal commodity page offers today's 12 germinal lines, and the live-animals page no longer does
rows.detail: The 9 October afternoon ruling splits the germinal commodity work so the germinal set is not held up by the MDM catalogue. The germinal set's copy of today's 'What are you importing?' page carries the germinal search hint and offers the 12 germinal lines today's live-animals catalogue holds, named and coded as today, found through today's server-side search behind its Search button. Splitting today's lines between the sets is set architecture, not list content, so it goes ahead now: the live-animals catalogue gives up those 12 lines, and neither set offers the other's commodities.
acceptanceCriteria: The germinal 'What are you importing?' page keeps the live-animals title, caption, heading, ITAHC inset, label, buttons, Cancel link and Back link to the origin page, and its search hint reads 'You can search for semen, ova or embryos, or by common name (for example, cattle), Latin name (Bos taurus) or commodity code (05119985).' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-057, -p3-058, -p3-078; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-097; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-020)

The germinal page offers the 12 germinal lines today's live-animals catalogue holds, with today's names and codes: Embryos/Ova for Cattle, Goat, Horse, Pig and Sheep (05119985), still one combined line each; Semen for Cattle (05111000); and Semen for Dog or Cat, Horse, Goat, Pig, Rodent/Rabbit and Sheep (05119985). (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-019, -p2-020; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-026)

Searching on the germinal page works through today's Search button, with or without JavaScript: typing alone shows no results, and searching 'semen' then pressing Search lists the seven semen lines. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-067, -p2-020)

The germinal search finds no live-animal commodity: searching 'cattle' offers only the cattle Embryos/Ova and Semen lines. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-025; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-098)

The live-animals search never offers semen, embryos or ova: searching 'semen', 'embryos' or 'ova' on a live-animals notification finds nothing. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-026; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-021)

Ticking a germinal line's species and saving takes the germinal notification on as the live-animal page does, and reopening the page shows the selection. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-013, -p2-020; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-064)
notes: Split from inc-016 by ruling claims pm-p2-012 and pm-p2-019: this row keeps the page copy (req-069), the split of catalogues (req-092) and today's 12 germinal lines (req-1927, which conflicts.json and requirements.json number req-1927; areas.json does not yet list it), and keeps inc-016's id. V4's 18-item catalogue (req-093), its search results (req-1782) and selection panel (req-1783) move to the blocked MDM rows below.

Ruling claim pm-p2-008 moves req-1754 (the live catalogue giving up its germinal lines) from the MDM-blocked inc-012 into this row; it is another area's requirement, so the combiner adds it here. This row therefore no longer depends on inc-012 (blocked on MDM) or inc-014 (moved to waiting-on-design by pm-p1-067).
The live-animals commodity service is in commodities-and-reason's touches; this row changes it only to remove the 12 germinal lines, so it is listed under shared for the combiner to place.
The germinal set's catalogue is its own commodity service, a copy of the live-animals one.

rows.title: Once commodities come from MDM, the germinal catalogue holds V4's 18 items, with embryos and ova separate and each its own GBN-AG type
rows.detail: V4 sets which germinal commodities the data applies to, and the GBN-AG schema has separate EMBRYO and OVA codes, so embryos and ova become separate items. The 9 October afternoon ruling makes this catalogue wait until commodities come from MDM and the germinal catalogue is re-distilled from that list. When it lands, the germinal catalogue holds V4's 18 items, each offering the species Design Release 2.1 lists, selections show as the live-animal search shows them, and each germinal trade line on GBN-AG carries the code for its own product type.
acceptanceCriteria: The germinal catalogue holds 18 items, sorted by name, codes shown with their leading zero: Cattle, Goat, Horse, Pig and Sheep each as '<Animal>, Embryos' and '<Animal>, Ova' (05119985); 'Cattle, Semen' (05111000); and 'Cat, Semen', 'Dog, Semen', 'Goat, Semen', 'Horse, Semen', 'Pig, Semen', 'Rabbit/Rodent, Semen' and 'Sheep, Semen' (05119985). There are no Cat or Dog embryos or ova and no poultry, fish or bee germinal products. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-050 to -p1-063; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-037, -p1-038; conflict c-230 default)

Each germinal item offers the species Design Release 2.1 lists for its animal: Cattle offers Bison bison, Bos taurus and Bubalus bubalis, with Bovidae as well for semen; Horse offers Equus asinus and Equus caballus; Goat Capra hircus; Pig Sus scrofa domesticus; Sheep Ovis aries; Cat Felis catus; Dog Canis familiaris; and Rabbit/Rodent, Semen one row labelled Rabbit/Rodent. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-138, -p2-141 to -p2-143, -p2-145 to -p2-155-m1, -p3-037; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-061, -p3-062)

Ticking Domestic cattle (Bos taurus) under Cattle, Semen shows '1 selected' with a 'Cattle, Semen (05111000):' line and a 'Bos taurus' chip, as the live-animal search does. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-063; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-012)

In the published GBN-AG payload each germinal trade line carries the typeCode SEMEN for a semen item, EMBRYO for an embryos item and OVA for an ova item, and embryos and ova are always separate trade lines, never one 'Embryos/Ova' line. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-036 to -p1-039; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-028)
openQuestions: Blocked on MDM (ruling 9 October afternoon, point 2): commodities must come from MDM and the germinal commodity catalogue and search be re-distilled from that list before this row can be written for real. Until then the germinal set offers today's 12 germinal lines (req-1927) with interim typeCodes (req-1928).

c-230: does the germinal catalogue hold only V4's 12 germinal commodities, or also Design Release 2.1's Cat and Dog embryos and ova? Default, carried here: V4's 12 with embryos and ova split and 'Semen - Dog or Cat' shown as separate Cat, Semen and Dog, Semen, 18 items; Cat and Dog embryos and ova are not offered.
notes: Combines V4's catalogue (req-093), its selection panel (req-1783) and the separate EMBRYO and OVA trade lines (req-1800): all three wait on the same MDM catalogue and change once it lands. req-1800 leaves the Commodity details row (inc-017), which now carries the interim codes (req-1928).

A new row: it holds the blocked half of inc-016 (ruling claim pm-p2-012). Depends on the draft row 'The germinal commodity page offers today's 12 germinal lines, and the live-animals page no longer does' (inc-016) and 'Germinal Commodity details asks total gross weight, number of packages and temperature, and the backend stores them' (inc-017), and on whichever row brings MDM commodities to the live-animals catalogue (inc-012).

rows.title: Waiting on design: the germinal commodity search lists V4's results as the trader types
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1's germinal search lists each commodity with its code and species as the trader types, and announces the number of results. That is the germinal copy of the search-as-you-type increment, which the 9 October afternoon ruling moves to waiting-on-design under design question 3, and its results are V4's catalogue, which waits on MDM. It is built as design says once both are settled, or dropped if design drops the behaviour.
acceptanceCriteria: Typing 'semen' in the germinal search lists the eight semen commodities in name order (Cat, Semen; Cattle, Semen (05111000); Dog, Semen; Goat, Semen; Horse, Semen; Pig, Semen; Rabbit/Rodent, Semen; Sheep, Semen, all others 05119985), offering 12 species rows, and the live region announces '12 results available'; Cattle, Semen offers 'Bovidae' and Rabbit/Rodent, Semen offers 'Rabbit/Rodent' as group rows. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-059 to -p3-062; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-098; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-067)
openQuestions: Waits on design's answer to design question 3 (commodity search as you type): built as design says, or dropped if design drops it (ruling 9 October afternoon, claims 57, 67 and 108).
Also blocked on MDM: the results are V4's germinal catalogue, which waits until commodities come from MDM and the germinal catalogue is re-distilled from that list.
notes: A new row. Ruling claim pm-p1-056 puts every design-blocked increment in the waiting-on-design theme ('Waiting on design: JavaScript-only behaviour from the prototype'); this row belongs there, not in germinal-products. Ruling claim pm-p1-067 says the germinal copy follows inc-014, so it depends on inc-014 (the live as-you-type increment, now in waiting-on-design) and on the draft row 'Once commodities come from MDM, the germinal catalogue holds V4's 18 items...' for the catalogue it lists.
Kept apart from the MDM catalogue row because it carries a second blocker (design question 3) the catalogue does not.

rows.title: Germinal Commodity details asks total gross weight, number of packages and temperature, and the backend stores them
rows.detail: The germinal set's copy of Commodity details asks, for each chosen species, an optional 'Total gross weight' in kilograms and a 'Number of packages', and always asks one optional 'Temperature' for the consignment. A germinal commodity has one Selected commodities row. The animals backend stores the gross weight as a decimal and the temperature on every line, and shows them back; neither is published, because the current PIMS profile (gbn-ag-pims v0.2.0) has no field for them. Until the germinal catalogue separates embryos from ova, each germinal trade line on GBN-AG carries an interim typeCode: SEMEN for a semen line and EMBRYO for a combined 'Embryos/Ova' line.
acceptanceCriteria: Each germinal species block asks 'Total gross weight' in a narrow text input with the suffix 'kg', before 'Number of packages'; left blank it shows no error. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-030; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-031; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-032; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-011; conflict c-232)

Each germinal species block asks 'Number of packages', with no hint and no '(when required)', and never asks the number of animals. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-029, -p3-034; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-032, -p5-034; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-033)

After all commodity blocks the page always asks one 'Temperature' radio question, its legend at label size rather than a heading, hint 'How will the products be stored', options Ambient, Chilled and Frozen in that order; left unanswered it shows no error. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-039, -p3-040; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-033; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-034; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-019 to -p1-025; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021; conflict c-232)

A germinal commodity has one Selected commodities row listing all its chosen species, such as '05111000 | Cattle, Semen | Bos taurus'; its block is headed '<name> (<code>)', such as 'Cattle, Semen (05111000)', and its species sections are separated by section breaks. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-030; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-031)

A saved total gross weight such as 24.5, the number of packages and the temperature are shown again when Commodity details is reopened; the backend holds the weight as that species line's gross weight in kilograms, as a decimal, and the temperature on every commodity line of the notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-022, -p1-040, -p1-042; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-006, -p1-012; conflict c-022)

The GBN-AG notification the backend publishes for a germinal notification gives each trade line its number of packages as its quantity, and carries no gross weight and no temperature. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-041 to -p1-043; conflict c-234 default)

In that published payload a germinal semen line carries typeCode SEMEN and a combined 'Embryos/Ova' line carries typeCode EMBRYO. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-027, -p2-029; conflict c-273, c-282)
openQuestions: c-234: is a germinal line's quantity its number of packages or its total gross weight in kilograms? Default, followed here: the page asks both; 'Number of packages' is the line's quantity, published as v0.2.0's whole-number quantity, and 'Total gross weight' is the line's gross weight in kilograms, stored as a decimal and not published.

Interim EMBRYO for a combined 'Embryos/Ova' line rests on Sam not objecting rather than an active approval (ruling claim pm-p2-029); built as the default, so a combined line submitted before MDM records ova as embryos.
notes: Combines the three questions (req-121, req-123, req-124), the selected commodities row (req-125), their storage (req-122) and the interim typeCodes (req-1928): one page copy and one backend change to the species line and the GBN-AG mapper.

req-1800 (separate EMBRYO and OVA lines) moved to the blocked MDM catalogue row; req-1928 (interim codes, numbered req-1928 in requirements.json, not yet listed in areas.json) takes its place here. The combiner keeps the other areas' requirements this row held (req-1889, req-1895, req-1894): the live LIVE_ANIMAL typeCode is set in the same mapper change.
Publishing is observed in the backend's own tests of the published payload on submit, before the germinal declaration page is copied.
c-022 (ruled): the answer is a gross weight, not the prototype's netWeight key. c-232 (ruled): weight and temperature are optional, with no blank errors.

rows.title: Germinal Commodity details checks weight and packages
rows.detail: V4 caps the germinal total gross weight at 1,000 kg to 2 decimal places and above 0, and makes the quantity mandatory to proceed, up to 1,000. Design Release 2.1 counts packages in whole numbers from 1 and gives the messages it has; the rest follow the GOV.UK pattern. Valid answers continue as the journey says.
acceptanceCriteria: A Total gross weight that is not a number greater than 0 (digits with an optional decimal part, no sign, commas or units), such as 0, shows 'Enter a number greater than 0', linked from the error summary to that species' field and shown inline. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-033; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-039; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-036; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-008)

A Total gross weight over 1,000, such as 1000.01, shows 'Total gross weight must be 1,000kg or less', linked to that species' field and shown inline; 1,000 is accepted. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-007, -p1-048)

A Total gross weight of 1.5 or 24.50 is accepted; one with more than 2 decimal places, such as 1.555, shows 'Total gross weight must have 2 decimal places or fewer', linked to that species' field and shown inline. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-009, -p1-012; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-041; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-022)

A blank Number of packages shows 'Enter the number of packages', linked from the error summary to that species' field and shown inline. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-035, -p3-035-m1; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-036; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-015)

A Number of packages that is not a whole number of 1 or more, such as 'x' or 0, shows 'Enter a whole number greater than 0', in the error summary and inline. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-036; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-040; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-037; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-017)

A Number of packages over 1,000 shows 'Number of packages must be 1,000 or less', linked to that species' field and shown inline; 1,000 is accepted. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-014, -p1-016, -p1-018; conflict c-234 default)
openQuestions: c-234: the default makes 'Number of packages' the line's quantity under V4's Quantity rules (required, whole number, 1 to 1,000); this row builds the 1,000 limit on that default.
notes: Split from the Commodity details questions row so neither is too big to review in one sitting: this row is the page's validation, that row is its questions and storage.
Where valid answers go (req-1790, Identification details) sits in the identification row (inc-052), the first row with a germinal identification page to land on.
The combiner keeps req-1762 (error order by question, another area's) in this row, with its 'blank weight and temperature save' and error-order criteria.

rows.title: The germinal opening run and main import reason: two reasons and four purposes
rows.detail: A germinal notification is started from the type question's Germinal products option or from 'Create new' on the germinal set's own notification list at /germinal-products, skips the type question, opens at the germinal origin page and runs through 'What are you importing?' to 'Main import reason' as live animals does. The germinal set's copy of the main import reason page offers only Internal market and Transit, and Internal market reveals only four purposes, each with the live-animal wording. A reason or purpose outside these lists is never saved.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Create new' on the germinal set's own notification list at /germinal-products creates a germinal products draft without asking the type question and lands on the germinal origin page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-087; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-102; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-053, -p3-054; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-095)

The germinal origin page shows only 'Save and continue', and its Back link returns to the germinal set's own notification list. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-056; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-096; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-109; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-087)

Saving the germinal origin page goes to the germinal 'What are you importing?' page, and saving a germinal selection there goes to the germinal 'Main import reason' page, in the order live animals uses. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-064, -p5-029; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-099)

The germinal main import reason page asks 'What is the main reason for importing the animals?' with only Internal market and Transit, in that order: Internal market hinted 'For imports of animals intended for sale or use in Great Britain (England, Scotland or Wales).' and Transit with its live-animal hint; the page ends with Save and continue, Save and return to overview and 'Cancel and return to overview'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-023, -p4-025; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-065 to -p3-070; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-100)

Choosing Internal market reveals 'Purpose in the internal market' with only Transfer of ownership - Sale/gift, Breeding, Research and Production, in that order, each with its live-animal hint. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-040; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-068; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-101)
Submitting a purpose outside those four with Internal market shows 'Select a purpose in the internal market', in the error summary and inline. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-065)
Submitting a main reason outside Internal market and Transit, such as Re-entry, saves no reason: reopening the page shows nothing chosen. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-074)
notes: Combines the germinal opening run (req-127) with the germinal reason lists (req-169, req-170, req-1799): the run ends on the reason page, and one germinal walk proves both.

c-281 (ruled, 9 October afternoon): the INS germinal list's 'Create new' is not built in this programme; the germinal set's own list at the set root (inc-141, moved to the germinal-products theme by ruling claim pm-p3-087) is where 'Create new' starts a germinal notification and where the origin Back link goes. So this row now depends on inc-141, which must itself depend on inc-176, not the other way round.
The type question's Germinal option start is proven in inc-176. The origin Back link for other contexts (the type question, the overview, the template review) is req-1740, placed by the combiner.

rows.title: Germinal identification asks once per species for donor, dates and identification number, and the backend stores them
rows.detail: Germinal products are identified once per species, whatever their number of packages. The germinal set's copy of Identification details shows each germinal species one editable form with V4's four optional fields, saved by the page's own buttons and prefilled with what was saved. The animals backend stores the four fields and shows them back; none is published, because gbn-ag-pims v0.2.0 has no field for them.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid germinal Commodity details continue to the germinal Identification details page. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-041, -p5-042; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-038)

Each germinal species panel keeps its species heading and a 'Change number of animals' link to Commodity details, worded as for live animals. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-074; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-071)

Each germinal species shows one editable form headed 'Enter details for <species>' with no count, such as 'Enter details for Bos taurus', whatever its number of packages, with no panel button and no saved-entries table. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-044, -p5-047; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-069; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-054)

The form asks 'Donor name/ID' (text), 'Collection date', 'Production date' and 'Identification number/mark' (text), in that order, for every germinal commodity the set offers. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-018, -p5-019; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-072 to -p5-075, -p5-080-m1; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-026, -p1-031, -p1-036, -p1-041, -p1-046, -p1-049, -p1-049-m1)

Values typed into each germinal species' form are saved by the page's 'Save and continue' and by 'Save and return to overview', and are shown prefilled when the page is opened again. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-047; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-083; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-046, -p1-047)
notes: Combines the step from Commodity details (req-1790), the panel heading and link (req-262), the one-form panel (req-250) and its four fields (req-251): one page copy, proven by one germinal walk. The combiner keeps the other areas' requirements this row held (req-1776 packages column, req-1892 backend storage, with its 'stored but not published' criterion) and merges req-252 (the date fields as single text inputs) wherever it places it, with inc-053.

'For every germinal commodity the set offers' replaces 'in the catalogue': until MDM the set offers today's 12 germinal lines (req-1927), and V4's four fields apply to every germinal commodity either way.
Where the donor details sit on the record is decided in the build from the real model, not the prototype's shape (ruling claims 46 and 47).

rows.title: Germinal identification dates and donor: single text inputs with V4's date and length checks
rows.detail: On the germinal set's copy of the identification page, the collection and production dates are built now as single text inputs (the 9 October afternoon ruling, design question 12), and the identification fields follow V4's donor length rule and date leniency, with every error listed in field order and linked to its own field. The 'Choose date' calendar waits on design in its own row.
acceptanceCriteria: A Donor name/ID over 58 characters shows 'Donor name/ID must be 58 characters or less', in the error summary and inline; 58 characters is accepted. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-077; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-056; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-027, -p1-029, -p1-030; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-095)

A collection date of 1/9/2026, a production date in the past or in the future, and a production date earlier than the collection date all save with no error and read back exactly as entered. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-081; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-062; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-034, -p1-035, -p1-039, -p1-040)

A submission with several invalid germinal fields re-renders the page with the error summary listing its errors in field order (Donor name/ID, Collection date, Production date, Identification number/mark), each linking to its own field, which is shown in error with its message inline. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-080, -p5-084; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-059; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-095)
The germinal date fields have no 'Choose date' calendar toggle until design answers design question 12. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-095, -p1-096)
notes: Ruling claim pm-p1-095 builds inc-053 now with single text inputs and V4's checks (req-252, req-254 to req-260, req-1797); claim pm-p1-096 moves the calendar (req-253) out to its own waiting-on-design row, so the old 'Choose date' criterion is removed here.

The combiner merges in the animal-identification area's germinal-only requirements this row held (req-252 single text inputs and hint, req-255 to req-259 date format, real-date and identification number length errors, with their nothing-saved-on-failure and Welsh criteria), so the germinal date checks land together on one page.
Depends on the draft row 'Germinal identification asks once per species for donor, dates and identification number, and the backend stores them' (inc-052).

rows.title: Waiting on design: the germinal dates' 'Choose date' calendar
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 renders the germinal collection and production dates with the MoJ date picker's 'Choose date' calendar. MoJ advises against its date picker for dates a user reads from a document, so the 9 October afternoon ruling builds the dates now as single text inputs and asks design (question 12) whether the calendar stays, or a plain date field or the GOV.UK date input will do instead. This row builds what design answers, enhancing the text inputs built now, or is dropped.
acceptanceCriteria: If design keeps the calendar: each germinal date field has a 'Choose date' toggle opening a month grid with previous and next year and month buttons, 'Select' and 'Close', and picking a day fills that date's text input; without JavaScript the text input works as before. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-076; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-096, -p1-108)

If design answers that the GOV.UK date input will do instead: each germinal date is asked as Day, Month and Year fields, and the V4 date checks of the single-input row still apply to the date they make. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-096, -p1-108)
openQuestions: Waits on design's answer to design question 12 (germinal dates): whether the MoJ date picker's calendar stays, or a plain date field or the GOV.UK date input will do instead. Built as design says; if design answers a plain date field, nothing changes and the row is dropped (ruling 9 October afternoon, claims 57, 96 and 108).
notes: A new row, split from inc-053 by ruling claims pm-p1-055 and pm-p1-096. It belongs in the waiting-on-design theme ('Waiting on design: JavaScript-only behaviour from the prototype', claim pm-p1-056), not germinal-products, and depends on inc-053, whose no-JavaScript text inputs it builds on (claim pm-p1-057).
The MoJ frontend package is already a dependency of the frontend.

rows.title: The germinal set has no Additional details step, and a germinal species counts as identified once it has one identifier
rows.detail: The germinal set leaves out the Additional details page: its overview has no Additional details task, and a valid identification page reached through the journey goes straight to Arrival details. Every germinal identification field is optional on its own, but V4 needs at least one germinal identifier: every selected germinal species, a lone species included, counts as identified, for the overview's Complete status and for submit, once its entry holds at least one of the four.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal notification's overview has no Additional details task: its section 2 holds 'Commodity details', and 'Identification details' where it applies, only. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-138-m1; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016, -p1-057)

'Save and continue' on a valid germinal identification page reached through the journey goes straight to Arrival details; opened from its overview task, the review or the template review, it returns there instead. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-085; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-063; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-196)

Saving a germinal species' form partly or wholly blank shows no missing-value error and never stops 'Save and continue'. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-060; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-082; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-028, -p1-033, -p1-038, -p1-043)

The overview's Identification details task shows Complete only once every selected germinal species, a lone species included, has at least one of the four identifiers saved; the identification page shows no message for this rule. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-061; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-188, -p1-189; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-086; conflict c-277)

Submitting a germinal notification with a species whose entry holds no identifier, a lone species included, is refused, and it submits once that species has one identifier. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-003, -p1-004; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009, -p1-188, -p1-189; document:dr1-parity-notes document-dr1-parity-notes-p1-085; conflict c-277)
notes: Combines the missing Additional details step (req-181) with the one-identifier bar (req-261): both are the germinal set's flow and obligation rules around identification, and both can only be observed once the germinal hub, review, template review, Arrival details and declaration copies exist. Kept apart from the identification page rows so those build early.
c-277 (ruled): a lone germinal species is not exempt; the prototype's lone-species exemption is not copied. c-041 and c-235 overruled claims are not used.
Depends on the germinal hub (inc-099), review (inc-105), the rest of the journey (inc-182), template mode (inc-186) and the identification page (inc-052).
